name: ultra-wide-angle-emma-watson-eerie-crouch
image_vibe: Unsettling calm anti-glam composition with mirror-room distortion and stark red tailoring
image_purpose: Create a conceptual editorial portrait exploring uncomfortable perspective and anti-glam styling.

prompt.project_info: A vertical conceptual portrait of an original adult woman crouching low in a royal mirror room with an intentional ultra-wide distortion effect.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with a pulled-back tight ponytail, wide-set hazel eyes, blank pressed-lip expression, and unsettling calm. She crouches low with knees pointed outward, neck craned forward toward camera, and fingers splayed awkwardly on the floor. She wears a structured marble-red high-neck top, asymmetrical short skirt, and chunky long leather boots.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme low-angle vertical composition from near floor level, 14mm ultra-wide lens, crouching subject close to camera, visible mirror floor in a royal mirror room, and intentional but controlled facial and limb perspective distortion for an anti-glam editorial effect.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard overhead light creating harsh shadows, stark reflective mirror-room atmosphere, unsettling calm and deliberately uncomfortable fashion mood, with clear texture on leather, mirror, and floor.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical portrait, 14mm ultra-wide lens at f/4, extreme low angle, intentional optical distortion controlled to preserve anatomy, high-resolution photorealistic editorial photography, realistic skin and material texture, subtle film grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical conceptual photorealistic fashion portrait of an original adult woman in a royal mirror room. Give her a pulled-back tight ponytail, wide-set hazel eyes, blank pressed-lip expression, and unsettling calm. Crouch her low with knees pointed outward, neck craned forward toward the camera, and fingers splayed awkwardly on the floor. Dress her in a structured marble-red high-neck top, asymmetrical short skirt, and chunky long leather boots. Use an extreme low-angle composition from near floor level, a 14mm ultra-wide lens at f/4, a visible mirror floor, and intentional but controlled facial and limb perspective distortion for a deliberately uncomfortable anti-glam editorial effect. Light the room with hard overhead light creating harsh shadows, preserve realistic anatomy despite the optical distortion, render detailed skin, leather, mirror, and floor texture, add subtle film grain, and include no text or watermark. Use an original face and do not imitate a public figure.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, graphic horror, broken anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, melted mirror, uncontrolled distortion, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, watermark, text

assets.name: source eerie ultra-wide mirror-room portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for crouching pose, mirror floor, marble-red top, asymmetrical skirt, boots, 14mm perspective, and hard overhead light; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult anti-glam concept, crouching pose, royal mirror room, red tailoring, asymmetrical skirt, boots, ultra-wide distortion, and unsettling calm. Use an original face and keep distortion controlled.

changes: Removed the named public-figure identity and replaced it with an original adult subject while retaining the anti-glam concept.
